places.name: Fujairah Sea View (Dibba coast)
places.area: Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Rd, Dibba
places.description: A rocky stretch of coast next to the Dibba coast road with open views over the Gulf of Oman and the Hajar Mountains. A quick photo stop when you're in the area; nothing to buy, so bring water.

places.name: Abandoned Masjid Dibba
places.description: An old abandoned mosque with a white minaret among the ruins of a former neighbourhood in Dibba, popular for photography. It may be demolished at some point, so check before driving out specially; respect the site.

places.name: Lake Dibba (Al Rakbi Dam)
places.description: A small lake behind Al Rakbi dam outside Dibba, surrounded by mountains. Accessible by any car; a short scenic stopover rather than a full outing, best after the winter rains when there's more water.
